A few things you might be wondering

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Something else on your mind?

Call (916) 707-5385 ↗
How do I get an estimate?+

Use the request form below to prepare an email, or call JCP at (916) 707-5385. Include your property address and the work you have in mind. JCP will confirm the details and pricing directly.

Can I ask about regular lawn care?+

Yes. Select ongoing yard care and your preferred frequency in the form. Visit schedules and availability need to be confirmed with JCP for your address.

What if my yard needs more than mowing?+

Tell us about edging, leaves, overgrowth, or other areas that need attention. JCP can discuss which work is available and what should be included in your estimate.

Which areas do you serve?+

JCP Lawn Service is based at 10448 Malaga Way in Rancho Cordova. Call or include your address in an estimate request to confirm service coverage.

Can I book a visit through this website?+

The form starts a conversation; it does not book a visit. Your message opens in your email app for you to send. Dates, work, and pricing are agreed directly with JCP.

What should I include in my request?+

Your contact details, property address, preferred service, and visit frequency are a useful start. Mention gate access, pets, problem areas, and whether you’re looking for a one-time cleanup or regular care.
